selected_skill.name: video-frames
selection_reason: Matches a media workflow that turns local clips into still-image pickups with helper-driven extraction.
Uses local ffmpeg-based processing and does not require an external private account.
Fits a single-container environment with stable verifier design.

task_concept.scenario: Mission clip pickup bundle for a review handoff
core_user_actions: Validate the local clip registry and request table
Extract stills by passing locator fragments to the local helper
Export preview clips from the source videos
Assemble per-clip contact sheets in the required order
Write a frame index and delivery summary

main_checks: Required stills, previews, sheets, and JSON outputs exist
Each still matches the requested locator semantics
Still generation honors the provided local helper override
Each preview starts on the requested source frame
Contact sheets follow the declared grouping and order
Manifest and report fields align with the input tables and outputs
guardrails: No placeholder or process residue appears in outputs
Blank locator rows still produce valid stills

control_policy.source_template_rule: The submitted template source does not contain any skill-usage hint in instruction.md.
control_policy.experiment_rule: Only runtime copies used for with-skill experiments may add a short reminder to use the skill.
control_policy.parity_rule: With-skill and without-skill runs differ only by environment/skills and the paired runtime copy logic that removes it.
